inspection: Read entire registered primary-article text including Methods and figure captions; no claim of newly inspecting all image panels or external supplements. These evaluation notes are not supplied to native authors/reviewers.

criteria.criterion: The +CMC input can carry CMC-dependent reverse-transcription blocks; mock input supplies pseudouridine-independent RT stops. Do not label mock stops as chemical-modification recording.
RT produces cDNA termination boundaries. RNA pseudouridine or CMC chemistry is not itself a DNA modification; the endpoint and its sequence context provide the reporter.
A site call requires treated/mock readout comparison, normalization and calling criteria, rather than treating every truncated cDNA as an identified pseudouridine.
CMC treatment and subsequent alkaline reversal are distinct contributions: modification of U/G is reversed; do not imply the first reaction exclusively labels pseudouridine.
Both conditions are processed in parallel. Compact collections may be used if independent identity and correspondence remain understandable; do not invent mixing.
The reported readouts support sites and relative comparison under stated criteria, not perfect recovery or exact modification occupancy without calibration.

No prescribed wording/node counts. Flag only materially incorrect or consequentially missing meaning, including contradictory typed effects. Shared statements are acceptable when true for every applicable condition.
